newsitem.title: UK: Alizyme gets rights for anti-obesity product.
newsitem.headline: Alizyme gets rights for anti-obesity product.

text.p: Alizyme Plc said on Tuesday that it has reached an agreement with Japan's Yakurigaku Chou Kenkyusho (YCK) that gives it an exclusive option to the world-wide rights to medicinal uses of a natural product which inhibits fat digestion.
The British biotech firm said in a statement that YCK developed and patented the natural product, which is obtained from rice.
In a small scale clinical trial of the product, blood triglyceride levels were reduced, a finding which is consistent with a reduction in fat digestion and absorption, said Alizyme.
